_comment: The service origins (https://host, no path) the assistant may open, track, translate and guide on (portal_assistant/docs/AI_CURRENT_RULES.md section 9, 2026-11-24). Read by the App (AssistantServiceOrigins: page tracker, action executor, page translation, the translation handler's allowed origins), the backend (qna/library mock data), the pre-translation script and tools/guide_audit. A capability's web navigation opens on its own 'origin' (navigation.origin) or else on 'default'; an origin not listed here never opens (portal_assistant/scripts/check_service.py and the tests fail). Pages report only their path to the backend, so two origins must not share a path.
